edges: Oxbridge has become a de facto category term for a type of educational institution.
Oxbridge entrants tend to go to a fee-paying private school rather than a free state school.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Some Oxbridge candidates are offered a place regardless of whether they deserve it or not.

edges: Oxbridge does not select students based on anything other than merit.
